question: Can C0300 be removed in place without changing the mirror or mixing graphics lifetime into native handle closing?
procedure: Inspect all five mirror callers listed by the existing linked-relocation evidence.
Trace event creation and graphics identity ownership in current source.
Compile nt_timer.c with its actual production command plus isolated /DMvdmCloseConsoleHandle=CloseHandle; inspect COFF references and compiler diagnostics.

trial.newDiagnostic: conapi.h(24): C4273 CloseHandle inconsistent dll linkage
trial.decision: Do not promote this command-line alias. It rewrites the provider declaration as well as the call and conflicts with the SDK dllimport declaration. No production source or graph changed. C0300 remains open.
trial.scope: Only nt_timer.c native heartbeat thread CloseHandle; not proof that all callers can bypass graphics owner.

callers.nt_error.c: CloseHandle(hThread) closes the CreateThread result after waiting. Native thread.
callers.nt_event.c: EventMgr thread and hConsoleWait/hConsoleSuspend CreateEvent results. Native thread/events.
callers.nt_timer.c: ThreadInfo.HeartBeat.Handle closes native heartbeat thread on STATUS_ALERTED.
callers.nt_msscs.c: NTIO/ROM input file handles from CreateFile. Native files.
callers.nt_graph.c: sc.ScreenBufHandle needs graphics object retirement; sc.ConsoleBufInfo.hMutex is native. The same file contains both kinds.

decision: Reject command-line alias: introduces C4273 and changes imported declaration. Keep C0300 open. Assign the graphics identity creation/activation/retirement group to S13; preserve original C drawing algorithms. Resolve native-handle fallthrough together with the graphics binding, not separate per-file macros. Do not move session-owned F graphics implementation wholesale into B.
evidenceLimits: This is source/compile classification, not new runtime acceptance.
No solution is implemented or dependency counted eliminated by this receipt.
Existing base_resource binding owns authenticated BaseSrv resource requests, not graphics lifetime; reusing it would require an ownership redesign, not a simple function move.
verification: Isolated compile exited 0 but is rejected due to new C4273 diagnostic. Documentation governance and git diff --check passed. No product change: no new build, runtime test or publication claimed.
